name: g_hands_up
about: Both hands up by the head and pumping at the sky, a lean back with it, from mx_hh_raise_roof (0.2-2.3 s). Plays `base` (IdleBreathe) under it from the start, so the take has a clip of its own and nothing adds up when it is baked or played alone (base 0 leaves what plays underneath).
